# Warehouse COSMIC

Native Rust/libcosmic Flatpak toolbox and standalone headless CLI.

- CLI executable: warehouse-cosmic-cli
- Flatpak CLI: flatpak run --command=warehouse-cosmic-cli dev.nilltadios.WarehouseCosmic
- Discover: warehouse-cosmic-cli commands --json
- Describe: warehouse-cosmic-cli describe COMMAND
- Request schema: warehouse-cosmic-cli schema
- Run: warehouse-cosmic-cli run --cmd 'command.id={"params":"value"}'
- Scripts: warehouse-cosmic-cli run --script job.json
- Mutations are plans unless --apply is supplied.
- System mutation also needs --allow-system and can show PolicyKit.
- Backend commands require no MCP, background server, listening socket, or running GUI.
- ui commands: inspect/control a live GUI through its own desktop D-Bus interface; no separate server.
- ui commands and ui schema discover the GUI API; select an exact instance when several are running.
- docs/cli.md: contract, parameters, scripts, exit codes, roots, recovery
- docs/agents.md: inspect, plan, apply and verify workflow
- schemas/commands.json: generated command catalog with parameter schemas
- schemas/request.json: generated request JSON Schema
- examples/audit.json: read-only audit
- docs/verification.md: reproducible tests and known limits
- docs/flatpak.md: runtime, build, signed publishing, permissions and updates
- docs/project-brief.md: product goals and UI requirements
- docs/ui-cli.md: live GUI actions, native pointer checks, captures and limits
